fast: files=; for f in tests/*.test.mjs; do case "$f" in tests/check-*) ;; *) files="$files $f" ;; esac; done; exec node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON --test $files
validate: failed=0; for t in . .claude-plugin/plugin.json skills; do claude plugin validate --strict "$t" || failed=1; done; exit $failed
